title: Hanz J NDE 2646
content: There was about twenty-five minutes from when I slid off a bed to waking up in an ambulance. The person I was with punched me in the chest and I breathed in deep and laid on my side. Ambulance and fire came. They rolled me on my back - heart stopped for two minutes and they brought me back - picked me up to put me on stretcher and died again for two minutes. Switched paramedic. Firefighter broke ribs. Brought me back. They didn't move me for fifteen minutes. (All according to a girl that saved me, and a neighbor, and paramedics) Then off to hospital. I regained consciousness in ambulance. While out... Very short time. Silhouette of women in black. Remember black patent leather shoes and either holding black lace or black lace around her waist. Couldn't see her but knew it was my grandmother that had died before I was born. There was a faint light behind her. No tunnel. I can see how people mistake a tunnel. It's more that there is just darkness everywhere else and just a light. No tunnel. That's it and I woke up. Though I am very different today. The same but different. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: March 27, 2006 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Allergic reaction Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Flat lined twice for two minutes. Brought back by paramedics. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness It was not the same. Though I don't recall being super aware or far away. It just was. I don't know how to explain. There were no regular body feelings. I just was there. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? While seeing light and grandmother. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? Neither Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't remember hearing anything. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Saw grandmother. No talking. There was a 'Knowing'. She sent me back or stepped in between. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm the place where i saw my grandmother. though dark and not visually beautiful had a peace to it What emotions did you feel during the experience? Calm. No feeling. Safe. It's hard to have feelings without a body I guess. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Neither Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither I am having an awful a lot of coincidences. Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I have a peaceful feeling inside me that has not wavered. What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I have a peaceful feeling inside me that has not wavered. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I knew that she intervened and that I had a purpose and to not turn my back again. I don't know the purpose just that I'm not done here. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I don't judge people. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes To express that there was a feeling that has no words. It just was. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I told siblings. I don't want to tell anyone else because I can't put into words what happened. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: Silhouette of a woman in black identified as his grandmother (died before he was born); remembered black patent leather shoes and black lace (holding it or around her waist).

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as dark, with a faint light behind the grandmother; 'darkness everywhere else and just a light'; 'place where i saw my grandmother... had a peace to it' (not visually beautiful).

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He felt his grandmother intervened/sent him back and that he 'had a purpose' and is 'not done here,' but he did not know the specific purpose.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Allergic reaction; flat-lined twice for two minutes each and was revived by paramedics.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Reported 'Moderate' prior to experience and 'Liberal' after (no specific denomination stated).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE and no tunnel; experience consisted of seeing a faint mystical light and the silhouette of his deceased grandmother, with a barrier/being 'sending back,' then waking in the ambulance.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Emphasis that there was 'no tunnel'; he suggested people may misinterpret it as a tunnel because there is darkness everywhere else and a single light. Grandmother presented as a silhouette in black with remembered shoes and lace; communication described as a 'Knowing' without talking.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Silhouette of women in black.” “There was a faint light behind her.” “No tunnel.” “There was a 'Knowing'. She sent me back or stepped in between.” “United, one with the world.” “Everything about the universe.” “I had a purpose and to not turn my back again.”
